examined_formations.title: SHANGHAI_BULKY_FURNITURE_DISPOSAL_REUSE_AND_PAID_SHORT_HAUL_HANDOFF
examined_formations.chinese_title: 上海大件旧家具处置、再利用与付费短驳交接摩擦
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: An April 2026 Shanghai resident trying to dispose of an old mattress reported that the community garbage room would not accept bulky waste and that property/neighborhood channels could not give a clear route; she also tried listing it free for self-pickup but nobody wanted to move it.
Another resident objected to an unexpected on-site collection charge, saying she was willing to pay but wanted a clear published price and process.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Some discarded furniture still has usable or donation value, but moving and handling costs can exceed the recoverable item value, producing a cost-inversion problem rather than simple absence of demand.
Shanghai's September 2026 bulky-waste rules now explicitly support second-hand trade, donation and refurbishment, while defining resident-paid door-to-drop short-haul service as a market-priced item.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Residents temporarily keep unwanted furniture, attempt free self-pickup listings, call property/community channels, pay ad-hoc movers, or in some cases abandon items in public space.
Current districts are deploying appointment mini-programs, fixed collection points, special collection days and contracted clearing units to close the handoff.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The item may have remaining use value, yet transport/disassembly cost prevents a direct second-hand flow; when it has no positive resale value, the resident becomes the payer for removal.

Shanghai already has multiple public/private channels and district appointment flows, so the unresolved problem is heterogeneous local coverage, physical handling and endpoint economics rather than a wholly missing digital matcher.
economic_signal: Current reporting gives explicit examples of resident-paid disposal and moving charges, while the September 2026 rules explicitly recognize a market-priced door-to-drop short-haul fee.
This is real external money flow, but the margin attaches to labor, vehicles, disassembly and local processing rather than to a founder-independent digital routing layer.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Shanghai districts already operate appointment mini-programs and contracted clearing networks; the city also points residents to existing recycling, second-hand and community channels.
The September 2026 rules assign district authorities, property managers and contracted clearing units specific responsibilities, with clearing vehicles connected to municipal management systems.
A generic agent can explain routes and compare options but cannot perform the physical short-haul, disassembly or resource-processing work.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_CROSS_HOSPITAL_IMAGING_AND_TEST_RESULT_PORTABILITY
examined_formations.chinese_title: 中国跨院影像与检验结果调阅互认
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: In an August 2026 Xi'an report, a man accompanying his 72-year-old mother described years of carrying multiple hospitals' imaging bags and the burden of repeat CT examinations when changing hospitals; the current visit used the city imaging cloud instead.
The participant's old workaround was manual physical transport of films plus acceptance of repeat testing when prior results could not be reliably accessed or accepted.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Medical images and reports already exist digitally inside hospitals; the underused endowment is prior diagnostic data that historically could not be conveniently retrieved across institutions.
National guidance targets cross-institution result access and recognizes data transmission/storage as part of the inspection service infrastructure.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Patients historically carried film bags and paper reports between hospitals or repeated tests; current cloud platforms allow authorized clinicians to retrieve prior images and reports.

Jiangsu's health-cloud platforms already support large-scale image and laboratory result retrieval and mutual recognition, with current Suzhou policy requiring qualifying results to be recognized when clinically appropriate.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The digital state transfer is technically achievable and is already happening at scale, but final recognition remains clinician- and quality-dependent rather than an unconditional data-routing decision.
The remaining gaps include non-participating institutions, data quality, mutual-recognition scope and clinical change, all inside public health-information and medical-governance control surfaces.
economic_signal: The value is substantial because successful recognition avoids time, cost and unnecessary repeat exposure; Jiangsu previously estimated large aggregate savings from reduced duplicate checks.
However the payer is not purchasing an independent new router: the core data rail is government/health-system infrastructure and medical institutions retain clinical decision authority.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: National policy requires provincial health information platforms, imaging clouds and related infrastructure for cross-institution access.
Jiangsu and Suzhou already operate the authoritative cloud and mutual-recognition mechanism, with standardized quality-control and physician judgment rules.
A generic software operator cannot independently create hospital data access, clinical recognition rights or medical quality equivalence.

examined_formations.title: JIANGSU_AGRICULTURAL_MACHINERY_CROSS_REGION_SCHEDULING_AND_EMERGENCY_MATCHING
examined_formations.chinese_title: 江苏农机跨区作业调度与抢收应急匹配
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A June 2026 Nanjing/Liuhe farm operator growing 1,200 mu of wheat reported that his usual machine operator had gone on cross-region work and, as wheat ripened, he could not find a harvester; the local agriculture authority ultimately coordinated four machines for a three-day harvest.

A June 2026 cross-region machine operator in Jiangsu said that previously finding work depended on luck, while current local support stations help with work information, repairs, rest and payment disputes.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Harvesters and other agricultural machines are mobile productive assets whose utilization changes sharply by crop maturity, weather and geography; simultaneous local shortages and remote idle/available capacity can coexist.
Jiangsu's supply-and-marketing system reports more than 20 million mu of annual agricultural socialized-service coverage, demonstrating a large existing service base rather than an isolated anecdote.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Farmers ask local authorities or cooperatives for emergency machine coordination when usual operators are unavailable.
Machine operators travel across regions following seasonal demand, historically relying on personal networks/luck and increasingly using service centers and online ordering.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The complementary flow is unquestionably real: mobile machinery already moves across regions to meet time-critical field demand.

The exact digital matching mechanism is also already productized. A current Jiangsu agricultural-service app, Maliduo, explicitly matches farmers with machine operators and is headquartered in Xuzhou's Yunlong District.

Local governments and cooperatives additionally operate emergency teams and coordination groups, so reliability depends on physical machine location, weather, operator availability, transport approvals and service execution.
economic_signal: Farmers pay for machine operations and the service ecosystem covers millions of mu; missing the harvest window has direct crop-value consequences.
The presence of a current Xuzhou-based exact matcher plus cooperative/government coordination means transaction value is real but does not establish a new generic routing white space.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Maliduo, based in Xuzhou, explicitly offers online machinery matching across plowing, planting, crop protection and harvesting using algorithmic dispatch.
County agricultural-socialized-service platforms and cooperatives already accept orders and dispatch nearby machines.
Agriculture authorities also coordinate emergency teams during peak windows, while machine owners/operators retain the physical execution asset.
